issues.on_page: Allocation From General Fund 19,215.13 (Employee Benefit column and Total Governmental Funds, p9; Schedule D p20)
issues.issue: Transfer cross-check: there is no General Fund outflow anywhere in the trimmed PDF. General Fund Total Disbursements 4,787,512.99 (p10) = the sum of its program lines (checked), and its only transfers are 135,000 (Activities 65,000 + School Nutrition 70,000, Schedule M p32). No Schedule M program/object line equals 19,215.13 or 300,000, there is no reclassification/elimination column, the General Fund budget (Schedule B p18) budgets only 160,000 of transfers, and Schedule N (pp33-34) ties exactly to the General Fund tax receipts. The government-wide Exhibit II itself counts 19,215.13 as Employee Benefits 'Charges for Services' (p4) and keeps it out of its 135,000 Transfers line. Keeping it as a receipt to match the printed total 6,733,808.11 is defensible. But it is labelled an interfund allocation, the same line is section 'other financing' in detail[133], and category 'other' is a last resort. decision_needed already covers this. The notes to the financial statements are not in the trimmed PDF, so they could not be checked.
